notes: 🎯 The Biggest gainers / Biggest falls boards now exclude shares priced below half a cent. On Market today, several 'gainers' were showing an identical +50.0% and several 'falls' an identical −33.3% — those weren't real moves. Below about half a cent the exchange records prices only to a tenth of a cent, so a single one-notch tick (a tenth of a cent) reads as +50% or −33% even when almost nothing happened. Those quantization artifacts were crowding genuine movers off the board. The boards now require a price of at least $0.005, so what you see are real percentage moves. 'Most active on volume' is unchanged — a big volume spike on a cheap share is still a real spike worth seeing. No change to any pick, grade or the robot.
